hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each catalog member is reconstructed by substituting the mapped value for theta0 in the latent template G(theta0); e.g. A_G0001 = G(theta0)[theta0 -> a].
required_assumptions: G is a unary function symbol
a, b, c are distinct declared symbols
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The three catalog expressions are non-identical only in their argument symbol, while the observed LGG template G(theta0) has one hole and substitution instances for a, b, and c. This supports a master-function representation with a single latent template and explicit substitutions.
